0	"## 1. ¿Qué significa entrenar un modelo?\n"
1	"Un modelo de ML aprende patrones a partir de datos históricos para generalizar sobre datos no vistos."
3	
cell_type	"markdown"
id	"be906a9b"
metadata	{}
source	
0	"## 2. Overfitting vs Underfitting\n"
1	"- **Overfitting:** memoriza el entrenamiento, falla en nuevos datos.\n"
2	"- **Underfitting:** modelo demasiado simple.\n"
3	"\n"
4	"### Analogía\n"
5	"Memorizar respuestas del parcial vs entender la materia."
4	
cell_type	"markdown"
id	"be0e4fa5"
metadata	{}
source	
0	"## 3. División de Datos\n"
1	"- Train: aprendizaje\n"
2	"- Validation: ajuste de hiperparámetros\n"
3	"- Test: evaluación final"
5	
cell_type	"code"
execution_count	null
id	"6a6cb0c5"
metadata	{}
outputs	[]
source	
0	"from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer\n"
1	"from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n"
2	"import pandas as pd\n"
3	"\n"
4	"data = load_breast_cancer()\n"
5	"X = pd.DataFrame(data.data, columns=data.feature_names)\n"
6	"y = pd.Series(data.target)\n"
7	"\n"
8	"X_train, X_temp, y_train, y_temp = train_test_split(\n"
9	"    X, y, test_size=0.30, random_state=42, stratify=y\n"
10	")\n"
11	"\n"
12	"X_val, X_test, y_val, y_test = train_test_split(\n"
13	"    X_temp, y_temp, test_size=0.50, random_state=42, stratify=y_temp\n"
14	")\n"
15	"\n"
16	'print("Train:", X_train.shape)\n'
17	'print("Validation:", X_val.shape)\n'
18	'print("Test:", X_test.shape)'
6	
cell_type	"markdown"
id	"4e4f0643"
metadata	{}
source	
0	"## 4. Data Leakage\n"
1	"Ocurre cuando información del test influye en el entrenamiento.\n"
2	"\n"
3	"### Ejemplos comunes\n"
4	"- Escalar antes de dividir\n"
5	"- Imputar usando todo el dataset\n"
6	"- Variables derivadas del target"
7

0	"## 5. Primer Modelo Base\n"
1	"Usaremos Regresión Logística como baseline de clasificación."
8	
cell_type	"code"
execution_count	null
id	"8b59f5e3"
metadata	{}
outputs	[]
source	
0	"from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline\n"
1	"from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n"
2	"from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression\n"
3	"\n"
4	"pipeline = Pipeline([\n"
5	"    ('scaler', StandardScaler()),\n"
6	"    ('model', LogisticRegression(max_iter=500))\n"
7	"])\n"
8	"\n"
9	"pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)"
9	
cell_type	"markdown"
id	"c5bca809"
metadata	{}
source	
0	"## 6. Predicción y Matriz de Confusión"
10

outputs	[]
source	
0	"from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay\n"
1	"import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n"
2	"\n"
3	"y_pred = pipeline.predict(X_test)\n"
4	"\n"
5	"cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)\n"
6	"disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm, display_labels=data.target_names)\n"
7	"disp.plot()\n"
8	"plt.show()"

0	"## 7. Métricas de Evaluación\n"
1	"\n"
2	"### Accuracy\n"
3	"\\[\n"
4	"Accuracy = \\frac{TP + TN}{TP + TN + FP + FN}\n"
5	"\\]\n"
6	"\n"
7	"### Precision\n"
8	"\\[\n"
9	"Precision = \\frac{TP}{TP + FP}\n"
10	"\\]\n"
11	"\n"
12	"### Recall\n"
13	"\\[\n"
14	"Recall = \\frac{TP}{TP + FN}\n"
15	"\\]\n"
16	"\n"
17	"### F1-Score\n"
18	"\\[\n"
19	"F1 = 2\\frac{Precision \\cdot Recall}{Precision + Recall}\n"
20	"\\]\n"
12	
cell_type	"code"
execution_count	null

outputs	[]
source	
0	"from sklearn.metrics import classification_report\n"
1	"\n"
2	"print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred, target_names=data.target_names))"
